scope: LS400, LS430, ES300 and ES330 acquisition and modeling research. Builds on the existing photo audit. This is not a completed geometry delivery or an exhaustive asset-market survey.
yearDecision: Existing catalog years are preserved. Alternative 2004 LS430 and 2003 ES300 years were proposed in the conversation but have not been selected by the owner.

sources.title: Lexus US 2000 LS400 brochure, pp. 1–2
sources.review: Document text reviewed; identifies nominal body dimensions, VVT-i V8, five-speed transmission and suspension-height options. No part coordinates.

sources.title: Lexus US second-generation LS400 archive
sources.review: Archive includes a labeled 2000 engine image and several 1998 engine images. Direct 2000 image fetch returned 403; its pixels were not reviewed in this pass.

sources.title: Lexus Canada 2000 LS400 photo archive
sources.review: Side-profile image 03 re-downloaded and visually inspected. Perspective and Canadian-market applicability remain limits. Existing audit rejects image 07 as a GS interior.

sources.title: Lexus US 2001 LS specifications, pp. 1–2
sources.review: Document text reviewed. Earlier LS430: five-speed automatic, standard and air-suspension dimensions distinguished.

sources.title: Lexus Canada 2004 LS430 specifications
sources.review: Six-speed transmission confirmed. Published 4995 mm length conflicts with the 5025 mm UK facelift specification; do not combine them into an exact US target.

sources.title: Lexus UK LS430 facelift launch pack, technical specifications pp. 36–37
sources.review: 3UZ-FE and A761E six-speed identified. UK specification: length 5025 mm, width 1830 mm, wheelbase 2925 mm. UK equipment is not proof of US installation.

sources.title: Victory Motors photographed 2004 LS430
sources.review: Engine-bay photograph inspected. Battery behind the right-side intake trim, central silver/black 4.3 cover and curved forward intake visible. Aftermarket battery and hidden hardware cannot establish original specification.

sources.title: Lexus US 2000 ES300 brochure, pp. 1–2
sources.review: Nominal dimensions, four-speed transmission and revised 2000 grille/bumper confirmed. This is XV20, separate from the proposed 2003 XV30 target.

sources.title: Victory Motors photographed 2000 ES300
sources.review: Engine-bay photograph downloaded and inspected. Silver/grey VVT-i cover with oil-cap opening and lower slots, rear cast intake runners, right-side airbox in the image, forward heat shield and radiator hose are visible. Replacement battery and service labels do not establish original equipment; hidden dimensions remain unknown.

sources.title: Toyota manufacturer 2003 VDS filing held by NHTSA
sources.review: Engine/model identification reference for the proposed 2003 alternative. It does not measure the installation or establish compatibility with the 2000 car.

sources.title: Lexus US 2004 ES brochure, performance and specifications
sources.review: 3.3-litre V6, five-speed automatic, ETCS-i and ACIS documented. Exterior uses the pre-2005 facelift appearance. Nominal US dimensions on printed p. 13: 191.1 × 71.3 × 57.3 inches; wheelbase 107.1 inches.

sources.title: Lexus Canada 2004 ES330 specifications, p. 5
sources.review: Nominal dimensions 4855 × 1810 × 1455 mm; wheelbase 2720 mm. Canadian equipment/options must remain separate from US fitment.

sources.title: Victory Motors photographed 2004 ES330
sources.review: Engine-bay photograph inspected. Silver 3.3 cover with oil-cap opening, rear cross-bay brace, rear intake, front exhaust heat shield and exposed alternator are visible. Green replacement battery is not an OEM color/size reference.

sources.title: Toyota/Lexus Technical Information System
sources.review: Access route only. No subscription purchased, no restricted manual retrieved and no repair procedure certified.

sources.title: Toyota/Lexus 2004 manufacturer VDS filing, p. 3
sources.review: Identifies ES330 as MCV31L with 3MZ-FE. Identification only; no component dimensions or installation interchangeability.

sources.title: Lexus UK revised LS400 launch pack, technical specifications p. 19
sources.review: Indexed technical specification identifies 1UZ-FE 90-degree V8 with VVT-i and five-speed automatic. US-specific equipment and dimensions use the US brochure instead.

targets.name: ES 300
targets.market: US / LHD / stock automatic; physical vehicle unidentified
targets.transmission: Four-speed automatic; proposed 2003 alternative belongs to a different generation
targets.dimensionStatus: published nominal values, not measured geometry
findings: The 1997 photoscan is XV20 before the 2000 grille and lower-bumper changes; it is not the proposed 2003 XV30 car either.
The scan preview has missing/distorted roof and windshield areas and includes ground geometry. It needs reconstruction, not just a material change.
The current target has front-wheel drive and a transverse engine bay; GS or LS longitudinal installation geometry is unsuitable.

firstModelingWork: Acquire the scan as a reference if access is supplied, then inspect scale and topology before accepting any part of it.
Reconstruct stock 2000 fascia, lamps and damaged scan regions against exact-year references.
Capture rear-bank clearance, intake and throttle connections, front accessory drive, radiator fans and battery tray.
blockers: Available scan is a different model year and visibly incomplete.
No exact-target complete licensed source was identified in this search.
No calibrated dimensions for internal or mating surfaces.

findings: Do not substitute the existing XV70 ES350 mesh; its body and powertrain belong to another generation.

captureRequirements.request: Record exact year, production month, market, steering side, engine/transmission tags, suspension and modifications. Use a pseudonymous car reference; do not publish the owner's details or full VIN.
Front, rear, both sides, roof and underbody with calibrated cameras and multiple scale references. Record wheel centers, body width excluding mirrors, wheelbase and ride height.
Overhead bay, both front quarters, firewall and front accessory drive. Include radiator support, strut towers and engine mounting datums.
Same camera positions with appearance covers removed by an appropriately skilled person. Capture otherwise hidden hose, connector and fastener relationships.
Multi-view captures of each removed component and its mating faces: bores, hole centers, mounting thicknesses, connector keying and hose diameters. Record uncertainty and measuring method.
Independent comparison of dimensions, stock identity, clearances and access on the reference vehicle before enabling repair instructions.

acceptance: Match a single year, market, facelift, engine, driveline and suspension configuration.
Establish original creator, license, permitted public GLB redistribution and required attribution.
Check front/rear/left/right/top/underbody against the reference before accepting a vehicle mesh.
Use metres without non-uniform stretching; compare several independent measured datums and report error and uncertainty.
Separate real selectable parts and mating faces; artistic material groups are not OEM parts.
Review engine-bay placement and physical access separately from exterior appearance.
Keep unmeasured surfaces explicitly provisional and prevent them from enabling repair procedures.
